results.name: security_definer_view
results.title: Security Definer View
results.description: Detects views defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property. These views enforce Postgres permissions and row level security policies (RLS) of the view creator, rather than that of the querying user
results.detail: View \`public.patient_summary\` is defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property

results.name: function_search_path_mutable
results.title: Function Search Path Mutable
results.description: Detects functions where the search_path parameter is not set.
results.detail: Function \`public.search_patients\` has a role mutable search_path

results.name: rls_disabled_in_public
results.title: RLS Disabled in Public
results.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has not been enabled on tables in schemas exposed to PostgREST
results.detail: Table \`public.profiles\` is public, but RLS has not been enabled.

results.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
results.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
results.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.
results.detail: Function `public.search_patients(q text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/search_patients`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

results.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
results.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
results.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.
results.detail: Function `public.search_patients(q text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/search_patients`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

results.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
results.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
results.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.
results.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.
